All edge cases work correctly:
- `compress([])` → `""`
- Single element → `"1"`
- Two consecutive → `"1,2"` (not a range, since ranges need 3+)
- Three consecutive → `"1-3"`
- Negative range → `"(-3)-(-1)"`
- Mixed range crossing zero → `"(-3)-0"` (negative endpoint in parens, zero plain)

The function is pure — no global state, no side effects, deterministic output for the same input.
